_comment: Canonical allowlist of internal URLs the blog writer can link to. Single source of truth. Loaded by blog_prompt.txt and blog_validator.py. Edit this file when a new service, industry, or case-study page ships on hexaaiagency.com.

services.label: AI workflow automation
services.use_when: the post is about automating a multi-step business process (intake, billing, reporting, AP)

services.label: AI agent development
services.use_when: the post is about building a custom agent (lead-response, voice, niche assistant)

services.label: CRM and AI integration
services.use_when: the post is about layering AI on HubSpot, Pipedrive, Salesforce, Follow Up Boss, etc.

services.label: customer service automation
services.use_when: the post is about triage, FAQ, chatbots, ticket deflection, or Shopify/Gorgias/Zendesk

services.label: proposal automation
services.use_when: the post is about quotes, proposals, contract docs, or sales-cycle compression

industries.label: property management
industries.use_when: the post addresses landlords, leasing offices, multifamily, tenant comms

industries.label: finance and accounting
industries.use_when: the post addresses AP, AR, bookkeeping, invoicing, QuickBooks, Xero

industries.label: healthcare
industries.use_when: the post addresses dental, medical, clinic ops (skip for anything regulated like diagnosis)

industries.label: retail and ecommerce
industries.use_when: the post addresses Shopify, returns, inventory, ecom support

industries.label: real estate
industries.use_when: the post addresses agents, brokerages, lead response, Follow Up Boss

case_studies.label: BD lead capture automation case study
case_studies.use_when: you're referencing inbound lead-capture / form-to-CRM builds

case_studies.label: Pipedrive contact enrichment case study
case_studies.use_when: you're referencing CRM enrichment, lead scoring, or data-quality work

case_studies.label: Pipedrive auto note-taker case study
case_studies.use_when: you're referencing call notes, transcription, sales-cycle automation

case_studies.label: ecommerce order automation case study
case_studies.use_when: you're referencing order flows, fulfillment, Shopify backend

case_studies.label: HubSpot CRM automation case study
case_studies.use_when: you're referencing HubSpot workflows, deal pipelines, sequences

case_studies.label: Instagram DM chatbot case study
case_studies.use_when: you're referencing IG / DM / ManyChat / social-comms automation

case_studies.label: AI chat system case study
case_studies.use_when: you're referencing on-site chatbots or LLM-powered conversational UX

case_studies.label: content engine case study
case_studies.use_when: you're referencing content production, blog/social automation

case_studies.label: proposal automation case study
case_studies.use_when: you're referencing quote / proposal / contract document work
